name: Cat President: 3rd-Rate Candidate
source:
Six cats. One presidency. Zero qualifications.

In a world where pets run the government, President DJ Nibbles has spent most of his time lying in sunbeams and using his desk as a scratching post. But now his days of zoomies in the Oval Office are coming to a close, as the U.S. prepares to elect its next Cat President!

Six wildly incompetent candidates are throwing their yarn balls into the ring, each more dysfunctional than the last. You’re the human campaign manager tasked with keeping these adorable candidates out of trouble. Wrangle egos, dodge scandals, [i]fall in love[/i], and maybe even save the country...or make it much, much worse.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2916480/Cat_President_3rdRate_Candidate/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
六只猫。一位总统。零资质。

在一个由宠物管理政府的世界里，总统DJ Nibbles大部分时间都躺在阳光下，把他的办公桌当作猫抓板。但现在，随着美国准备选举下一任猫总统，他在椭圆形办公室的大肆宣扬的日子即将结束！

六名极其无能的候选人将他们的毛线球扔进了擂台，每个人都比上一个更加失能。你是人类竞选经理，肩负着让这些可爱的候选人摆脱麻烦的任务。争吵自负，躲避丑闻，[i]坠入爱河[/i]，甚至可能拯救国家……或者让事情变得更糟。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2916480/Cat_President_3rdRate_Candidate/]Steam[/url]]
